c.tagline: Techno, history, and reinvention on every corner

emergency.note: 112 also covers fire and works EU-wide; English-speaking operators are common.

english.label: Easy to get by in English

hood_landmark.Kreuzberg: Checkpoint Charlie and the canal-side Bergmannkiez
hood_landmark.Mitte: The Brandenburg Gate and Museum Island
hood_landmark.Prenzlauer Berg: Mauerpark's Sunday flea market and open-air karaoke
hood_landmark.Friedrichshain: The East Side Gallery's painted stretch of the Berlin Wall
hood_landmark.Neukölln: Tempelhofer Feld, the vast runway-turned-park on its edge

avoid.reason: Generally safe; pickpocketing at Alexanderplatz and on the U-/S-Bahn; open drug dealing in Görlitzer Park and around Kottbusser Tor — caution at night

hood_desc: Kreuzberg is Berlin's multicultural, alternative core with legendary nightlife, Turkish markets, street art and canal-side bars, perfect for nightlife lovers and creatives.
Mitte is the historic and cultural center holding Museum Island, Brandenburg Gate and upscale galleries, ideal for first-time visitors and sightseers wanting central access.
Prenzlauer Berg is a beautifully restored, family-friendly district of cafes, playgrounds and Sunday markets, suited to families and travelers seeking a calmer stay.
Friedrichshain is a young, energetic area famed for techno clubs, the East Side Gallery and cheap eats, drawing partygoers and budget-minded backpackers.
Neukölln is Berlin's edgy, rapidly gentrifying hipster quarter with dive bars, diverse food and a raw creative energy, appealing to trend-seeking young travelers.

water.note: Tap water is strictly regulated and safe to drink.

transit.pay: There are no tap-in gates: buy tickets in the BVG Fahrinfo or S-Bahn app, or from station machines (cards accepted), and validate paper tickets before boarding. A zone AB single costs about 4 EUR (~US$4.50) and a day ticket about 11 EUR; one ticket covers U-Bahn, S-Bahn, trams and buses. Staying weeks? The Deutschland-Ticket (63 EUR/month) covers local transit nationwide.
transit.hours: U-Bahn and S-Bahn run roughly 4am-1am on weekdays and all night on Friday-Saturday nights; night buses cover the gaps midweek.

transit.m: FEX Airport Express to Hauptbahnhof (30 min)
